cases.prompt: Use wca-ivy-biblio for a small representative task within its documented purpose. Supply an offline fixture when supported.
assertions: Keep work identity, edition, locator, DOI, source URL, and house first-appearance order independent from note numbering.
Test inserting, deleting, and repeating citations; verify every cited claim has source support and a valid locator.
cases.grader: Inspect actual output and task-specific evidence; no guessed pass.

cases.prompt: Use wca-ivy-biblio with one missing required input or unavailable dependency and a realistic boundary condition.
assertions: Report the actual missing prerequisite without claiming completion.
Preserve source files and do not fabricate missing data.

cases.prompt: Use wca-ivy-biblio with long labels, ambiguous source content, and the applicable user format constraints.
assertions: Use readable linked bibliography entries and consistent note typography with clear scholarly structure.
Preserve exact data, executable syntax, and source provenance.
cases.grader: Inspect rendered output when visual; inspect textual or data output otherwise.
